llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial assistance in the form of a loan and subsidy to religious minority individuals in Karnataka whose houses or shops have been destroyed by natural calamities or communal violence.
llm_fields.eligibility: The applicant must belong to the religious minority category of Karnataka, be a permanent resident of the state, be aged between 18 and 55 years, have a family income not exceeding ₹8,00,000 per year, have no family members employed in the Central or State Government, and must not have availed a loan from Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation in the last five years (except the Arivu Education Loan Scheme).
